name: graph
description: Turn a coding goal into a validated execution graph, then review and run it from a local dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Plan work as a reviewable execution graph.
interface.longDescription: Graph confirms a three-layer Goal Charter (strategic / medium / fast), drafts mutually supervising loop bodies with adversarial review, publishes a draft, and opens a local dashboard for human review.
defaultPrompt: Use Graph to plan and execute this repository task.
Infer intent from conversation (plan / revise / execute). Execute → graph_start_run. Dashboard is display-only.
